exposure: Second-trimester ultrasound markers (e.g., estimated fetal weight, uterine artery pulsatility index, cervical length)
cohort: 9805 singleton pregnancies from a single tertiary institution (2012-2025).
finding: Predictive models using routine mid-gestation data showed significantly stronger predictive performance for iatrogenic preterm birth (AUC up to 0.862 for <32 weeks) compared to spontaneous preterm birth (AUC up to 0.749 for <32 weeks), with accuracy improving for earlier gestations.
